The Depot of Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen is the world’s first publicly accessible art storage facility.

[Book tickets now](https://www.boijmans.nl/en/tickets)

\* The Depot is accessible only with an online ticket

The Depot of Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen is the world’s first publicly accessible art storage facility. The depot is located next to Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen in Museumpark in Rotterdam. Visitors can see the result of over 175 years of collecting. More than 155,000 objects housed together, arranged in fourteen storage compartments with five different climates. Next to the objects, all the activities that go into preserving and managing a collection are on open view in the building.

[Marisol: a new exhibition in the making We are working hard on the preparations for our new exhibition, Marisol. Until Thursday 8 October, Galleries 1, 2 and 3 on the third, fourth and fifth floors of the Depot are temporarily closed to visitors. But there's good news: you can still get a glimpse behind the scenes and see our colleagues live at work.](https://www.boijmans.nl/en/news/marisol-a-new-exhibition-in-the-making "Marisol: a new exhibition in the making")

[3 evenings rooftop bar at the Depot On 13, 14 and 15 August 2026, the roof of the Depot transforms into a rooftop bar featuring music, art, performance and vibes. As the sun sets, enjoy drinks and snacks from Renilde, whilst taking in the view of the Rotterdam skyline. Let yourself be swept away by a varied programme featuring a.o. Studio de Zolder, Bound45 and FUGAZII.](https://www.boijmans.nl/en/news/rooftopbar "3 evenings rooftop bar at the Depot")

[Celebrate the summer holidays at the Depot Looking for a special day out for the whole family this summer? During the summer holidays, there’s plenty to discover every day for young and old alike at the Depot. From world-famous works of art to interactive digital installations and walk-in workshops in the education studio.](https://www.boijmans.nl/en/news/summer-holidays-2026 "Celebrate the summer holidays at the Depot")

[Opening Pixel Pioneers Last Friday marked the festive opening of our new exhibition Pixel Pioneers. It was a lively and inspiring evening in which art, audience, and creators connected in a truly special way. The energy could be felt in every space, and the conversations and responses made it clear how much this exhibition resonates.](https://www.boijmans.nl/en/news/opening-pixel-pioneers "Opening Pixel Pioneers")

[New exhibition in progress We’re hard at work on our new exhibition, Pixels Pioneers. From April 16 to 24, Galleries 2 and 3 on the fourth and fifth floors of the building will be temporarily closed to the public.](https://www.boijmans.nl/en/news/new-exhibition-in-progress "New exhibition in progress")

[Restoration reveals layered Van Gogh masterpiece From 7 February 2026 Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen presents Research on the Rails – Van Gogh’s Poplars. The presentation allows visitors to look at and under the paint surface of Poplars near Nuenen (1885-86). During the conservation work, discoloured layers of varnish were removed and damage repaired. The autumn landscape has now been brought to life again.](https://www.boijmans.nl/en/news/van-gogh-poplars-near-nuenen "Restoration reveals layered Van Gogh masterpiece")
